do.name: Climb the St Euphemia bell tower
do.detail: Wooden stairs inside the campanile lead to a view over the red roofs, the harbour and the islands scattered offshore.

do.name: Zlatni Rt forest park
do.detail: Holm oak and pine cover the cape south of town, with paths, climbing crags and quiet stony coves between them.

do.name: Eat Istrian: truffle, olive oil, malvazija
do.detail: Shaved truffle over pasta, peppery local oil, fish from the Valdibora stalls, and malvazija or teran poured by the glass.

do.name: Swim off the rocks below the church
do.detail: No sand here. People climb down the flat rocks under the old town, at Balota and Cisterna, and drop straight into deep water.

do.name: Grisia and the old town lanes
do.detail: The artisans' street climbs from the harbour to the church through hidden staircases and squares. Walk it early, before the day boats land.

do.name: Taxi boat to the archipelago islands
do.detail: Nineteen wooded islets lie off the harbour. Small boats run all day to St Katarina and St Andrew for a swim and a shaded walk.

do.name: Row out in a batana at dusk
do.detail: The flat bottomed local boat, on the UNESCO safeguarding register, rounds the old town at sunset and ends at a tavern with singers.

do.name: Cycle the coastal pine trails
do.detail: Flat gravel tracks run south through the pines and north past the bays, easy on a rented town bike and shaded most of the way.

do.name: Sunset from the harbour
do.detail: The town points west, so the whole waterfront turns out for it.
